china-1912:p0449_1.rationale: Composition of the Tzechengyuan National Assembly by member class with numbers of seats; a representative political institution.
review_questions: Would a vocabulary term for legislative bodies or assemblies be more precise than elections-and-parties?

china-1912:p0465_1.rationale: Number of members to be selected from each provincial assembly for the national assembly, by province; a representative selection quota.

china-1912:p0474_1.rationale: Chronological list of imperial decrees ordering protection of missionaries; content is textual with dates only.

china-1912:p0475_1.rationale: Numbered list of Roman Catholic missionary societies working in China; names only.

china-1912:p0476_1.rationale: Catholic vicariates by mission society with foreign and native priests, baptized converts and applicants, plus summary totals.

china-1912:p0479_1.rationale: Lists of Protestant missionary societies by nationality with first year of work, plus medical institutions; the years are incidental identifiers in a roster.

china-1912:p0482_1.rationale: List of schools where medicine is taught, mostly mission-related institutions; names only.
review_questions: Is a medical-education tag needed in the vocabulary?

china-1912:p0482_2.rationale: List of three educational societies; names only, no quantities.
review_questions: No fitting tag for mission educational societies; mission-schools is not clearly established.

china-1912:p0482_3.rationale: Tract societies with circulation in copies and expenditure; religious publication distribution.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for religious tracts or religious publishing.

china-1912:p0482_4.rationale: Mission statistics for 1910 and 1911: foreign and Chinese staff, stations, schools and scholars, congregations, hospitals and patients, contributions.
